author: reek
body: Integer and number-theoretic operations. GCD, LCM, primality test, prime factorization, modular arithmetic, Euler totient, Fibonacci, binomial coefficients, integer partitions, and Diophantine solvers. All pure integer math -- no floating point.

author: reek
body: Two `when` blocks on one line let the inner one swallow the outer's `is otherwise`, which left the outer match non-exhaustive over every constructor but ExInt. Splitting the inner into its own function is what makes each `otherwise` belong to the match it was written for.
